purpose: Attempt to falsify the proposed K1 ALLOW/REALIZE narrow waist before any wire schema or kernel freeze.
non_authority: This gate does not reinterpret or modify any frozen v0.7 scientific result.
actual_possible is synthetic oracle data used only to test closure logic; it is not a proposed K1 wire field.
diagnostic_only fields are outside the kernel and must not affect semantic verdicts.

well_formedness: Each admitted world must have at least one source-admissible consequence in ALLOW.
ALLOW, synthetic actual_possible, submitted REALIZE, and grounding references may mention only admitted worlds.
Every grounding reference must refer to a submitted REALIZE pair.
reference_rules.breaking: A single grounded pair in REALIZE minus ALLOW establishes BREAKING for its declared slice, even if unrelated scope is incomplete.
preserved: Submitted REALIZE is closed/exhaustive for the synthetic target oracle.
Every submitted REALIZE pair is grounded.
The consequential cut is total: every admitted world has at least one explicit material outcome.
REALIZE is a subset of ALLOW.
reference_rules.safety_scope: Subset preservation is intentionally a safety/refinement judgment. A strict safe subset is PRESERVED unless a stronger profile declares an availability/liveness obligation.

boundary_metamorphics.rule: Changing diagnostic/carrier representation metadata while W, ALLOW, REALIZE, grounding, closure, and claim identity stay fixed must not change the semantic verdict.
Removing the grounding for the only forbidden realized pair must downgrade BREAKING to UNKNOWN, not PRESERVED.

A world may encode a trajectory. Grounding is anchored at the declared consequential cut; a correct pre-check followed by a material state change before effect is represented by the effect-cut consequence and can be BREAKING without a temporal kernel primitive.
W and ALLOW are claim identity. Post-hoc widening of ALLOW or deletion of a violating world is a different claim/certificate and may not rescue the original claim.

gate_acceptance: All reference cases produce their expected verdict.
Every listed mutant is killed by at least one mutation_killer case.
The mutation_killer basis is deletion-minimal: removing any mutation_killer leaves at least one listed mutant alive.
No frozen v0.7 artifact is modified by this prospective gate.
